description: Fixed meteorological and marine monitoring stations and seismic stations is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by National Planning Council. This dataset presents the number of fixed meteorological, marine, and seismic monitoring stations in Qatar. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher National Planning Council. Its tags are meteorological stations, meteorology, seismic, marine, monitoring. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2025-05-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard and risk assessment. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
